snippet.title: Hellsino - Official Gameplay Trailer | Poker Roguelike Grid Tactics
snippet.description:
🃏 WISHLIST HELLSINO ON STEAM: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4730280/Hellsino_Pokerlike/

🔥 Play the free Demo right now in the June Steam Next Fest!

What happens when you combine classic poker hands with tactical grid positioning? You get Hellsino - a roguelike deckbuilder built specifically to solve the "bad RNG luck" problem.

In Hellsino, you don't just rely on the luck of the draw. Where you place your cards on the board determines your scoring multipliers, positioning combos, and tactical survival against the devil's dealer. Strategy, positioning, and mechanical synergy beat pure luck every single time.

💀 Key Features:

Poker Meets Tactics: Form traditional hands (Flushes, Straights, Full Houses) but position them strategically on a combat grid to trigger massive score multipliers.

Beat the RNG: Use tactical positioning mechanics to manipulate the board, swap cards, and bypass bad card draws.

Deep Roguelike Progression: Draft powerful items, unlock game-breaking modifiers, and build the ultimate deck to survive the 4-Act gauntlet.

Hand-Drawn Gothic Casino Art: Face off against unique bosses and dark dealer characters in a stylized underworld.
